Resolves #2814

Unifies base-list sorting (`sortBaseList`) with `onStoreFilter` in `Neo.list.plugin.Animate` (returning early when no filter transition is in flight and the sorted record order matches `previousItems` record-for-record) and wires `owner.onStoreLoad = me.ownerLoadHandler` unconditionally across `Neo.list.Base` and `Neo.list.Component`. Base-list sorts now skip `Store#onCollectionSort`'s coarse `isSort: true` `load` rebuild, skip no-op sorts without scheduling an update or settle pass, share `onStoreFilter`'s `motionSerial`, `pendingFilter`, and `transitionTimeoutId` interception, preserve leaving `renderedRecords` (`opacity: 0`) when a sort interrupts an in-flight filter transition, and settle once via `triggerTransitionCallback()`.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit suite `test/playwright/unit/list/animatePlugin.spec.mjs` + `check-jsdoc-types.mjs`) → L2 required (unit-testable `Neo.list.plugin.Animate` VDOM transition/settle behavior).

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline unit tests and check-jsdoc-types ran`

## AC Evidence
No structured ACs on #2814.
| Requirement | Verification |
|---|---|
| Combine `onStoreFilter()` and `onStoreSort()` (`sortBaseList`) in `Neo.list.plugin.Animate` so sorting during an in-flight filter transition does not corrupt VDOM nodes or race the transition timer, while preserving the early return for no-op sorts | `test/playwright/unit/list/animatePlugin.spec.mjs` (`base-list sort translates items to their sorted slots and settles the vdom order after transitionDuration (#2814)`, `sorting a base list while a filter transition is in flight preserves leaving fade-outs and settles once to the filtered+sorted set (#2814)`, `sorting a base list inside the first 50ms window of a filter coalesces into a single frame and settle pass (#2814)`, `a no-op base-list sort when no filter transition is in flight triggers no update() and no createItems() (#2814)`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Wired `owner.onStoreLoad = me.ownerLoadHandler` unconditionally in `Animate#construct` (previously gated on `owner instanceof Neo.list.Component`) so `Neo.list.Base` also ignores `Store#onCollectionSort`'s coarse `isSort: true` `load` event instead of rebuilding `vdom.cn` synchronously before `onStoreSort` runs.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [x] Unit tests (`42/42` in `test/playwright/unit/list/animatePlugin.spec.mjs`) and JSDoc type checks run in CI.
